name: Kangla Fort
description: Historical palace fort of ancient Manipur kings situated in the heart of Imphal city.

name: Keibul Lamjao National Park
description: World's only floating national park, home to the endangered Sangai brow-antlered deer.

name: Ramrei Eco Tourism Park
description: Scenic eco-tourism spot featuring picturesque dam views, boating, and peaceful hills.

name: Sana Konung
description: The Royal Palace of Manipur, serving as the ceremonial residence of the traditional King.

name: Ema Keithel (Mother's Market)
description: Historic 500-year-old market run entirely by women, selling local goods and handicrafts.

name: INA War Memorial
description: Historical memorial site in Moirang where the INA tricolor flag was first hoisted in 1944.

name: Khongjom War Memorial Complex
description: Commemorative monument dedicated to Major Paona Brajabashi and the 1891 Anglo-Manipur War.

name: Shirui Hills (Shirui Kashong)
description: Famous mountain peak known for the endemic Shirui Lily flower and scenic trekking.
best_season: May to June / Oct to Mar

name: Marjing Polo Complex
description: Features the world's tallest polo statue, celebrating Manipur as the birthplace of polo.

name: Loktak Lake
description: Largest freshwater lake in Northeast India, famous for floating phumdis and circular huts.

name: Khonghampat Orchidarium
description: Sprawling botanical park housing over 110 rare species of native orchids.

name: Khangkhui Lime Caves
description: Prehistoric limestone cave system with fascinating natural stone formations.

name: Dzukou Valley
description: Stunning high-altitude valley on the border, known for rolling green hills and trekking.

name: Tharon Cave
description: Long natural cave carved in limestone, famous for adventure caving and underground passages.

name: Maibam Lokpa Ching (Red Hill)
description: Historic World War II battlefield site where British and Japanese forces clashed.

name: Shaheed Minar
description: Memorial tower inside Bir Tikendrajit Park honoring martyrs of the 1891 war.

name: Andro Heritage Village & Mutua Museum
description: Cultural heritage village famous for traditional pottery, tribal houses, and artifacts.

name: Kakching Garden
description: Hilltop garden offering panoramic valley views, shrines, musical fountains, and statues.

name: Ikop Pat
description: Tranquil lake area ideal for wetland birdwatching, fishing, and peaceful boat rides.

name: Loukoipat Eco Park
description: Scenic eco-park surrounding a lotus-covered lake nestled among lush forested hills.

name: Singhat (Singuat)
description: Picturesque hill township known for pleasant weather, green hills, and tribal culture.

name: Kaina Temple
description: Sacred Hindu hillock surrounded by jackfruit trees, connected to King Bhagyachandra.

name: Baruni Hill
description: Revered pilgrimage hill dedicated to Lord Shiva, popular during Shivaratri festivals.

name: Churachandpur Peace Museum
description: Cultural hub highlighting southern tribal heritage, local handlooms, and history.

name: Zeilad Lake
description: Famous highland wetland sanctuary rich in aquatic fauna, pythons, and migratory birds.

name: Bungte Chiru Waterfalls
description: Cascading forest waterfall surrounded by lush green valley vegetation.

name: Willong Khullen Monoliths
description: Ancient megalithic stone alignment site often referred to as the Stonehenge of Manipur.

name: Yangkhullen Village
description: Traditional Zeme Naga village built on a steep cliff face, rich in ancient customs.

name: Sadu Chiru Waterfalls
description: Popular three-tiered cascading waterfall framed by scenic mountain terrain.

name: Ukhrul Town & Phangrei
description: Charming hill station area featuring rolling pine forests, grasslands, and local crafts.
